usedFor: viaSocket Table holds your records, and Razorpay collects the money when “New Row Created” runs “Create Payment Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Row Created” in viaSocket Table, then “Create Payment Link” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: Each new row becomes a shareable payment link with the amount and customer details you set.

watchOut: “Record Is Updated” also triggers, so an edited row can create a second link for the same customer.
